Liberation fonts 2.1.5 (https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts), SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE).
LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf: metric-compatible with Times New Roman (the interface fonts).
LiberationMono-Regular.ttf: metric-compatible with Courier New (the console font).
Unmodified, from liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz. Used by the native interface text path (docs/notes/ui-native.md).
